summary: Clothing improves Strength and grants Bull Rush.

fields.Bull’s Strength: +2 Strength, maximum 20. Advantage on Strength checks and double carrying capacity.
fields.Unwavering Bull: Cannot be pushed against your will. Advantage on saves against Restrained.
fields.Bull Rush: Action and movement, once per turn. Charge up to 30 ft, affecting targets within about 7 ft along the path. Strength save against weapon-action DC or push 10 ft. The copied tooltip incorrectly describes damage, Prone and a Rage requirement.
fields.Acquisition: Quartermaster Talli at Last Light Inn.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and exact item and dependency citations.
